page_title: VAL 1-1 VIL | Valencia v Villarreal 31/08/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+5' Valencia have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
90+3' Good team movement sets up Sergi Canos (Valencia) on the edge of the box, but he slices the ball narrowly wide of the right post.
90+2' A mid-range free kick is awarded to Valencia out wide and from this angle a cross into the box is likely.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
90' Sergi Canos (Valencia) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.

89' Sergi Canos (Valencia) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the right post is blocked by Diego Conde, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
87' Sergi Canos (Valencia) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
87' The linesman points to the corner flag, Valencia are going to take it.
85' It looked like the long-range shot by Pepelu (Valencia) would end up in the net, but the effort went painfully wide of the left post. The goalkeeper was quite lucky this time.
83' Raul Albiol (Villarreal) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
82' Ruben Baraja has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Javi Guerra (Valencia) replacing Andre Almeida.
82' We are about to witness a subsitution. Sergi Canos (Valencia) for Luis Rioja.
77' A substitution has been made. Ayoze Perez goes off and Juan Bernat (Villarreal) comes on.
77' A yellow card is awarded to Kiko Femenia (Villarreal).
75' Rafa Mir (Valencia) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the area, but he drags his shot just wide of the right post.
72' Diego Conde pulls off a fantastic save! Luis Rioja (Valencia) attempts to head home after a precise cross into the box. He aims his header towards the left post, but the effort is kept out.
72' Valencia have been awarded a corner kick.
72' The resulting set piece from Valencia is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players. Valencia earn a corner.

70' What a great touch by Luis Rioja (Valencia)! He picks up a precise pass on the edge of the box and immediately unleashes a shot on goal. His effort, however, only rattles the right post. What an unlucky moment for him.
70' Ruben Baraja prepares a substitution. Jesus Vazquez is replaced by Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia).
69' Substitution. Hugo Guillamon will be replaced by Rafa Mir (Valencia).
69' Marcelino has decided to make a change. Ramon Terrats (Villarreal) replaces Yeremy Pino.
68' Pape Gueye (Villarreal) does not realise that he has already received a yellow card and is shocked when the referee shows him a second one!
68' Pape Gueye (Villarreal) brings an opponent down and Jesus Gil Manzano interrupts the game.
66' Luis Rioja (Valencia) threw away a promising scoring opportunity. He received a fine cross inside the 6-yard box, but missed to the left of the target.
65' Pape Gueye (Villarreal) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar.
65' Villarreal take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
63' Jesus Gil Manzano blows his whistle and signals a foul after Hugo Guillamon (Valencia) brought his opponent down.
62' Hugo Guillamon (Valencia) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
62' The ball goes out of play. Valencia are awarded a corner kick.
61' 53:47 – the ratio of ball possession.
57' Villarreal get a corner.

56' Thierno Barry (Villarreal) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the bottom right corner. However, Giorgi Mamardashvili anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save.
52' Pepelu (Valencia) is punished with a yellow card for violating the rules.
50' Pape Gueye (Villarreal) gets booked for the first time in this match.
50' Jesus Gil Manzano blows the whistle, Pape Gueye (Villarreal) is penalised for a foul.
47' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Valencia comes to nothing.
46' Substitution. Ilias Akhomach (Villarreal) in, Dani Parejo out.
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.

45+4' 1 - 1 Stunning strike! Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) latches on to a precise through ball from Santi Comesana before unleashing an unstoppable shot into the top right corner from the edge of the area. Fantastic goal. The score is now 1:1.

45+3' Hugo Guillamon (Valencia) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Jesus Gil Manzano blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
42' Yeremy Pino (Villarreal) receives a harsh yellow card from the referee after committing a minor foul on his opponent.

41' Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) wins the aerial battle and plants a header at goal from near the penalty after a good cross from Yeremy Pino. It's a fine attempt but sails narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Valencia will have a goal kick.
41' Hugo Duro (Valencia) has an effort from distance but it's blocked.
39' This is a yellow card! Hugo Duro (Valencia) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
39' Pepelu (Valencia) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
39' Luis Rioja (Valencia) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. Good work from Valencia as they win a corner.
37' Giorgi Mamardashvili is alert and has a clear sight of a long through ball from Raul Albiol (Villarreal). Easy save!
33' The referee awards a corner and Luis Rioja (Valencia) goes over to take it.
33' Valencia failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat. The ball goes out for a corner. Valencia can continue in their attacking effort.
29' The corner is swung in but Valencia can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
27' The goal stands! That took a long time for referee Jesus Gil Manzano to decide it wasn’t offside. The relieved Valencia players can finally celebrate.
26' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Valencia players aren’t happy.
24' 1 - 0 What a hit! Hugo Duro (Valencia) shows good composure inside the box to fire a first-time shot into the bottom left corner. 1:0.
24' Pepelu (Valencia) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
23' Luis Rioja (Valencia) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger. Valencia will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
19' The ball is cleared after Luis Rioja (Valencia) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
17' He should have scored! Sergi Cardona (Villarreal) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block.
16' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Pepelu (Valencia).

15' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Luis Rioja (Valencia), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Valencia will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

13' Hugo Duro (Valencia) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Diego Conde pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
10' Thierno Barry (Villarreal) is penalised for a foul. Jesus Gil Manzano had a clear view and blows his whistle.
7' The game is interrupted as Yeremy Pino (Villarreal) is flagged offside.
4' Dani Parejo (Villarreal) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Villarreal will kick-off.
Today's referee will be Jesus Gil Manzano.
